result.brief: 面向嵌入式机器人世界模型规划的硬件-算法协同设计，给出潜空间状态转移的算力与能耗下界，并提出近存计算、变精度 rollout 与写时复制潜变量的加速器架构。
result.reason: Hardware-accelerator co-design for embedded world-model planning (DreamerV3 RSSM latent rollouts); contributes to world-model deployment efficiency rather than representation learning itself.
